definitions.gloss: progress report; interim report; status update
definitions.explanation: A report on the current status and progress of a project, treatment, investigation, or ongoing matter. Common in business, medical, and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please give us a progress report.

examples.japanese: {週|しゅう}に{一度|いちど}、プロジェクトの{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We give a project progress report once a week.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}から{手術後|しゅじゅつご}の{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}を{受|う}けて、{家族|かぞく}は{安心|あんしん}した。
examples.english: The family was relieved after receiving the post-surgery progress report from the doctor.

notes:
A compound of {経過|けいか} (progress, course of events) and {報告|ほうこく} (report). Used frequently in workplace and medical settings to describe periodic updates on ongoing situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}を{行|おこな}う: to make a progress report
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}を{受|う}ける: to receive a progress report
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}: written progress report
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}: interim progress report

USAGE:
In business, progress reports are a standard part of project management. In medical contexts, doctors provide {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく} to patients and their families about recovery or treatment progress.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{報告|ほうこく}: interim report — emphasizes being midway through
- {進捗|しんちょく}{報告|ほうこく}: progress report — focuses specifically on how far work has advanced
- {最終|さいしゅう}{報告|ほうこく}: final report — the concluding report
